title: Chrome Website Notifications Won't Stop? Fix the Permission #Shorts
description: A visual, original fictional learning example from FlowMinute Lab. Those endless notification popups may be coming from a site you allowed in Chrome. You can revoke that permission. Learn the safe verification step using the official product guidance below. Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/3220216 #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: THE SITE KEEPS PINGING
scenes.narration: Those endless notification popups may be coming from a site you allowed in Chrome. You can revoke that permission.

scenes.title: NOT A VIRUS PROOF
scenes.narration: A noisy notification by itself does not prove your computer is infected. First check which website received permission.

scenes.title: THE REAL SETTING
scenes.narration: On desktop Chrome, open Settings, Privacy and security, Site settings, then Notifications. Your version may label menus differently.

scenes.title: REMOVE THE EXCEPTION
scenes.narration: Find the unwanted site under allowed notifications and block it. Use quieter notification prompts if interruptions continue.

scenes.title: ONE CHECK
scenes.narration: The fix is permission control, not clicking scary alerts. Confirm the site is no longer allowed to notify you.
